title: Gathin23/cleanyourtv
why_read: A popular practical utility for debloating Android TV devices, useful to many but not technically groundbreaking.
analysis: This is a tool that strips bloatware and ads from Android/Google TV devices and replaces the home screen with something resembling the cleaner Apple TV interface. It's a genuinely useful consumer utility with high community adoption (nearly 28k stars), reflecting a widespread frustration with ad-laden smart TV interfaces. Technically it likely relies on ADB debugging and app-disabling scripts rather than novel engineering, so the interest is practical rather than deeply technical.
